scope: Persist one typed completion record across Single traces, GoalRunState, and Team delivery manifests
changes: Added the protocol-level TaskCompletionRecordV1 with task and attempt identity, shared CompletionStatusV1, deduplicated host evidence receipt IDs, candidate version SHA-256, and decision time.

Single traces now persist the completion record for normal and error turns, including the attempt-scoped execution/validation receipt IDs and a digest of changed path hashes; old traces remain readable.
GoalRunState now persists the same typed record for accepted, blocked, and cancelled terminal runs; Team success publishes that record in its delivery manifest and stores it in the run snapshot.
Added regression-test source for stable receipt normalization, trace persistence/backward compatibility, and GoalRunState disk persistence.
